verses.ar: «وَإِنْ سَمِعْتَ سَمْعًا لِصَوْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ لِتَحْرِصَ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ بِجَمِيعِ وَصَايَاهُ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُوصِيكَ بِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ، يَجْعَلُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ مُسْتَعْلِيًا عَلَى جَمِيعِ قَبَائِلِ ٱلْأَرْضِ،
verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe [and] to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
verses.web: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
verses.he: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁמֹ֤ועַ תִּשְׁמַע֙ בְּקֹול֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשֹׂות֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיֹּ֑ום וּנְתָ֨נְךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עֶלְיֹ֔ון עַ֖ל כָּל־גֹּויֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: وَتَأْتِي عَلَيْكَ جَمِيعُ هَذِهِ ٱلْبَرَكَاتِ وَتُدْرِكُكَ، إِذَا سَمِعْتَ لِصَوْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ.
verses.kjv: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.web: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
verses.he: וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל־הַבְּרָכֹ֥ות הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֻ֑ךָ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמַ֔ע בְּקֹ֖ול יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: مُبَارَكًا تَكُونُ فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ، وَمُبَارَكًا تَكُونُ فِي ٱلْحَقْلِ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [shalt] thou [be] in the city, and blessed [shalt] thou [be] in the field.
verses.web: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
verses.he: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

verses.ar: وَمُبَارَكَةً تَكُونُ ثَمَرَةُ بَطْنِكَ وَثَمَرَةُ أَرْضِكَ وَثَمَرَةُ بَهَائِمِكَ، نِتَاجُ بَقَرِكَ وَإِنَاثُ غَنَمِكَ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [shall be] the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.web: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
verses.he: בָּר֧וּךְ פְּרִֽי־בִטְנְךָ֛ וּפְרִ֥י אַדְמָתְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י בְהֶמְתֶּ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֥ות צֹאנֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: مُبَارَكَةً تَكُونُ سَلَّتُكَ وَمِعْجَنُكَ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [shall be] thy basket and thy store.
verses.web: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.
verses.he: בָּר֥וּךְ טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

verses.ar: مُبَارَكًا تَكُونُ فِي دُخُولِكَ، وَمُبَارَكًا تَكُونُ فِي خُرُوجِكَ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [shalt] thou [be] when thou comest in, and blessed [shalt] thou [be] when thou goest out.
verses.web: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
verses.he: בָּר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וּבָר֥וּךְ אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: يَجْعَلُ ٱلرَّبُّ أَعْدَاءَكَ ٱلْقَائِمِينَ عَلَيْكَ مُنْهَزِمِينَ أَمَامَكَ. فِي طَرِيقٍ وَاحِدَةٍ يَخْرُجُونَ عَلَيْكَ، وَفِي سَبْعِ طُرُقٍ يَهْرُبُونَ أَمَامَكَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
verses.web: Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.
verses.he: יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־אֹיְבֶ֙יךָ֙ הַקָּמִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ נִגָּפִ֖ים לְפָנֶ֑יךָ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ יֵצְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים יָנ֥וּסוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: يَأْمُرُ لَكَ ٱلرَّبُّ بِٱلْبَرَكَةِ فِي خَزَائِنِكَ وَفِي كُلِّ مَا تَمْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِ يَدُكَ، وَيُبَارِكُكَ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي يُعْطِيكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.web: Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
verses.he: יְצַ֨ו יְהוָ֤ה אִתְּךָ֙ אֶת־הַבְּרָכָ֔ה בַּאֲסָמֶ֕יךָ וּבְכֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וּבֵ֣רַכְךָ֔ בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: يُقِيمُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ شَعْبًا مُقَدَّسًا كَمَا حَلَفَ لَكَ، إِذَا حَفِظْتَ وَصَايَا ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ وَسَلَكْتَ فِي طُرُقِهِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
verses.web: Yahweh will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and walk in his ways.
verses.he: יְקֽ͏ִימְךָ֙ יְהוָ֥ה לֹו֙ לְעַ֣ם קָדֹ֔ושׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נִֽשְׁבַּֽע־לָ֑ךְ כִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־מִצְוֹת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ֖ בִּדְרָכָֽיו׃

verses.ar: فَيَرَى جَمِيعُ شُعُوبِ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَنَّ ٱسْمَ ٱلرَّبِّ قَدْ سُمِّيَ عَلَيْكَ وَيَخَافُونَ مِنْكَ.
verses.kjv: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
verses.web: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
verses.he: וְרָאוּ֙ כָּל־עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה נִקְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑יךָ וְיָֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃

verses.ar: وَيَزِيدُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ خَيْرًا فِي ثَمَرَةِ بَطْنِكَ وَثَمَرَةِ بَهَائِمِكَ وَثَمَرَةِ أَرْضِكَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي حَلَفَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِآبَائِكَ أَنْ يُعْطِيَكَ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.web: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.
verses.he: וְהֹותִרְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ לְטֹובָ֔ה בִּפְרִ֧י בִטְנְךָ֛ וּבִפְרִ֥י בְהַמְתְּךָ֖ וּבִפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ עַ֚ל הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: يَفْتَحُ لَكَ ٱلرَّبُّ كَنْزَهُ ٱلصَّالِحَ، ٱلسَّمَاءَ، لِيُعْطِيَ مَطَرَ أَرْضِكَ فِي حِينِهِ، وَلْيُبَارِكَ كُلَّ عَمَلِ يَدِكَ، فَتُقْرِضُ أُمَمًا كَثِيرَةً وَأَنْتَ لَا تَقْتَرِضُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
verses.web: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
verses.he: יִפְתַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה ׀ לְ֠ךָ אֶת־אֹוצָרֹ֨ו הַטֹּ֜וב אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם לָתֵ֤ת מְטַֽר־אַרְצְךָ֙ בְּעִתֹּ֔ו וּלְבָרֵ֕ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהִלְוִ֙יתָ֙ גֹּויִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֥א תִלְוֶֽה׃

verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ رَأْسًا لَا ذَنَبًا، وَتَكُونُ فِي ٱلِٱرْتِفَاعِ فَقَطْ وَلَا تَكُونُ فِي ٱلِٱنْحِطَاطِ، إِذَا سَمِعْتَ لِوَصَايَا ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُوصِيكَ بِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ، لِتَحْفَظَ وَتَعْمَلَ
verses.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do [them:]
verses.web: Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,
verses.he: וּנְתֽ͏ָנְךָ֙ יְהוָ֤ה לְרֹאשׁ֙ וְלֹ֣א לְזָנָ֔ב וְהָיִ֙יתָ֙ רַ֣ק לְמַ֔עְלָה וְלֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לְמָ֑טָּה כִּֽי־תִשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל־מִצְוֹ֣ת ׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיֹּ֖ום לִשְׁמֹ֥ר וְלַעֲשֹֽׂות׃

verses.ar: وَلَا تَزِيغَ عَنْ جَمِيعِ ٱلْكَلِمَاتِ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُوصِيكَ بِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ يَمِينًا أَوْ شِمَالًا، لِكَيْ تَذْهَبَ وَرَاءَ آلِهَةٍ أُخْرَى لِتَعْبُدَهَا.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, [to] the right hand, or [to] the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.web: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.he: וְלֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִכָּל־הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיֹּ֖ום יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול לָלֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים לְעָבְדָֽם׃ ס

verses.ar: «وَلَكِنْ إِنْ لَمْ تَسْمَعْ لِصَوْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ لِتَحْرِصَ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ بِجَمِيعِ وَصَايَاهُ وَفَرَائِضِهِ ٱلَّتِي أَنَا أُوصِيكَ بِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ، تَأْتِي عَلَيْكَ جَمِيعُ هَذِهِ ٱللَّعَنَاتِ وَتُدْرِكُكَ:
verses.kjv: ¶ But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
verses.web: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.
verses.he: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־לֹ֤א תִשְׁמַע֙ בְּקֹול֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֤ר לַעֲשֹׂות֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיֹּ֑ום וּבָ֧אוּ עָלֶ֛יךָ כָּל־הַקְּלָלֹ֥ות הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְהִשִּׂיגֽוּךָ׃

verses.ar: مَلْعُونًا تَكُونُ فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَمَلْعُونًا تَكُونُ فِي ٱلْحَقْلِ.
verses.kjv: Cursed [shalt] thou [be] in the city, and cursed [shalt] thou [be] in the field.
verses.web: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
verses.he: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בָּעִ֑יר וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

verses.ar: مَلْعُونَةً تَكُونُ سَلَّتُكَ وَمِعْجَنُكَ.
verses.kjv: Cursed [shall be] thy basket and thy store.
verses.web: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
verses.he: אָר֥וּר טַנְאֲךָ֖ וּמִשְׁאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

verses.ar: مَلْعُونَةً تَكُونُ ثَمَرَةُ بَطْنِكَ وَثَمَرَةُ أَرْضِكَ، نِتَاجُ بَقَرِكَ وَإِنَاثُ غَنَمِكَ.
verses.kjv: Cursed [shall be] the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.web: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.
verses.he: אָר֥וּר פְּרִֽי־בִטְנְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֥ות צֹאנֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: مَلْعُونًا تَكُونُ فِي دُخُولِكَ، وَمَلْعُونًا تَكُونُ فِي خُرُوجِكَ.
verses.kjv: Cursed [shalt] thou [be] when thou comest in, and cursed [shalt] thou [be] when thou goest out.
verses.web: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
verses.he: אָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּבֹאֶ֑ךָ וְאָר֥וּר אַתָּ֖ה בְּצֵאתֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: يُرْسِلُ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَ وَٱلِٱضْطِرَابَ وَٱلزَّجْرَ فِي كُلِّ مَا تَمْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِ يَدُكَ لِتَعْمَلَهُ، حَتَّى تَهْلِكَ وَتَفْنَى سَرِيعًا مِنْ أَجْلِ سُوْءِ أَفْعَالِكَ إِذْ تَرَكْتَنِي.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
verses.web: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.
verses.he: יְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה ׀ בְּ֠ךָ אֶת־הַמְּאֵרָ֤ה אֶת־הַמְּהוּמָה֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּגְעֶ֔רֶת בְּכָל־מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמֶדְךָ֤ וְעַד־אֲבָדְךָ֙ מַהֵ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֛י רֹ֥עַ מֽ͏ַעֲלָלֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲזַבְתָּֽנִי׃

verses.ar: يُلْصِقُ بِكَ ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلْوَبَأَ حَتَّى يُبِيدَكَ عَنِ ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتَ دَاخِلٌ إِلَيْهَا لِكَيْ تَمْتَلِكَهَا.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.web: Yahweh will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.
verses.he: יַדְבֵּ֧ק יְהוָ֛ה בְּךָ֖ אֶת־הַדָּ֑בֶר עַ֚ד כַּלֹּתֹ֣ו אֹֽתְךָ֔ מֵעַל֙ הֽ͏ָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

verses.ar: يَضْرِبُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ بِٱلسِّلِّ وَٱلْحُمَّى وَٱلْبُرَدَاءِ وَٱلِٱلْتِهَابِ وَٱلْجَفَافِ وَٱللَّفْحِ وَٱلذُّبُولِ، فَتَتَّبِعُكَ حَتَّى تُفْنِيَكَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
verses.web: Yahweh will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.
verses.he: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה בַּשַּׁחֶ֨פֶת וּבַקַּדַּ֜חַת וּבַדַּלֶּ֗קֶת וּבַֽחַרְחֻר֙ וּבַחֶ֔רֶב וּבַשִּׁדָּפֹ֖ון וּבַיֵּרָקֹ֑ון וּרְדָפ֖וּךָ עַ֥ד אָבְדֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ سَمَاؤُكَ ٱلَّتِي فَوْقَ رَأْسِكَ نُحَاسًا، وَٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلَّتِي تَحْتَكَ حَدِيدًا.
verses.kjv: And thy heaven that [is] over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee [shall be] iron.
verses.web: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
verses.he: וְהָי֥וּ שָׁמֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־רֹאשְׁךָ֖ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְהָאָ֥רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־תַּחְתֶּ֖יךָ בַּרְזֶֽל׃

verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُ ٱلرَّبُّ مَطَرَ أَرْضِكَ غُبَارًا، وَتُرَابًا يُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ حَتَّى تَهْلِكَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.web: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
verses.he: יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מְטַ֥ר אַרְצְךָ֖ אָבָ֣ק וְעָפָ֑ר מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ יֵרֵ֣ד עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: يَجْعَلُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ مُنْهَزِمًا أَمَامَ أَعْدَائِكَ. فِي طَرِيقٍ وَاحِدَةٍ تَخْرُجُ عَلَيْهِمْ، وَفِي سَبْعِ طُرُقٍ تَهْرُبُ أَمَامَهُمْ، وَتَكُونُ قَلِقًا فِي جَمِيعِ مَمَالِكِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.web: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.he: יִתֶּנְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה ׀ נִגָּף֮ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֶיךָ֒ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ תֵּצֵ֣א אֵלָ֔יו וּבְשִׁבְעָ֥ה דְרָכִ֖ים תָּנ֣וּס לְפָנָ֑יו וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְזַעֲוָ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכֹ֥ות הָאָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ جُثَّتُكَ طَعَامًا لِجَمِيعِ طُيُورِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ وَوُحُوشِ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَيْسَ مَنْ يُزْعِجُهَا.
verses.kjv: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray [them] away.
verses.web: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
verses.he: וְהָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָֽתְךָ֙ לְמַאֲכָ֔ל לְכָל־עֹ֥וף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּלְבֶהֱמַ֣ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃

verses.ar: يَضْرِبُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ بِقُرْحَةِ مِصْرَ وَبِالْبَوَاسِيرِ وَٱلْجَرَبِ وَٱلْحِكَّةِ حَتَّى لَا تَسْتَطِيعَ ٱلشِّفَاءَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
verses.web: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
verses.he: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֤ין מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ *וּבָעֳפָלִים (וּבַטְּחֹרִ֔ים) וּבַגָּרָ֖ב וּבֶחָ֑רֶס אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵֽא׃

verses.ar: يَضْرِبُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ بِجُنُونٍ وَعَمًى وَحَيْرَةِ قَلْبٍ،
verses.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
verses.web: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
verses.he: יַכְּכָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּשִׁגָּעֹ֖ון וּבְעִוָּרֹ֑ון וּבְתִמְהֹ֖ון לֵבָֽב׃

verses.ar: فَتَتَلَمَّسُ فِي ٱلظُّهْرِ كَمَا يَتَلَمَّسُ ٱلْأَعْمَى فِي ٱلظَّلَامِ، وَلَا تَنْجَحُ فِي طُرُقِكَ بَلْ لَا تَكُونُ إِلَّا مَظْلُومًا مَغْصُوبًا كُلَّ ٱلْأَيَّامِ وَلَيْسَ مُخَلِّصٌ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save [thee].
verses.web: You will grope at noonday, as a blind person gropes in darkness, and you will not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.
verses.he: וְהָיִ֜יתָ מְמַשֵּׁ֣שׁ בַּֽצָּהֳרַ֗יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְמַשֵּׁ֤שׁ הָעִוֵּר֙ בָּאֲפֵלָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחַ אֶת־דְּרָכֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֜יתָ אַ֣ךְ עָשׁ֧וּק וְגָז֛וּל כָּל־הַיָּמִ֖ים וְאֵ֥ין מֹושִֽׁיעַ׃

verses.ar: تَخْطُبُ ٱمْرَأَةً وَرَجُلٌ آخَرُ يَضْطَجِعُ مَعَهَا. تَبْنِي بَيْتًا وَلَا تَسْكُنُ فِيهِ. تَغْرِسُ كَرْمًا وَلَا تَسْتَغِلُّهُ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
verses.web: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.
verses.he: אִשָּׁ֣ה תְאָרֵ֗שׂ וְאִ֤ישׁ אַחֵר֙ *יִשְׁגָּלֶנָּה (יִשְׁכָּבֶ֔נָּה) בַּ֥יִת תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְלֹא־תֵשֵׁ֣ב בֹּ֑ו כֶּ֥רֶם תִּטַּ֖ע וְלֹ֥א תְחַלְּלֶֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: يُذْبَحُ ثَوْرُكَ أَمَامَ عَيْنَيْكَ وَلَا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ. يُغْتَصَبُ حِمَارُكَ مِنْ أَمَامِ وَجْهِكَ وَلَا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْكَ. تُدْفَعُ غَنَمُكَ إِلَى أَعْدَائِكَ وَلَيْسَ لَكَ مُخَلِّصٌ.
verses.kjv: Thine ox [shall be] slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass [shall be] violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep [shall be] given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue [them].
verses.web: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.
verses.he: שֹׁורְךָ֞ טָב֣וּחַ לְעֵינֶ֗יךָ וְלֹ֣א תֹאכַל֮ מִמֶּנּוּ֒ חֲמֹֽרְךָ֙ גָּז֣וּל מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְלֹ֥א יָשׁ֖וּב לָ֑ךְ צֹֽאנְךָ֙ נְתֻנֹ֣ות לְאֹיְבֶ֔יךָ וְאֵ֥ין לְךָ֖ מֹושִֽׁיעַ׃

verses.ar: يُسَلَّمُ بَنُوكَ وَبَنَاتُكَ لِشَعْبٍ آخَرَ وَعَيْنَاكَ تَنْظُرَانِ إِلَيْهِمْ طُولَ ٱلنَّهَارِ، فَتَكِلَّانِ وَلَيْسَ فِي يَدِكَ طَائِلَةٌ.
verses.kjv: Thy sons and thy daughters [shall be] given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail [with longing] for them all the day long: and [there shall be] no might in thine hand.
verses.web: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.
verses.he: בָּנֶ֨יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֜יךָ נְתֻנִ֨ים לְעַ֤ם אַחֵר֙ וְעֵינֶ֣יךָ רֹאֹ֔ות וְכָלֹ֥ות אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם כָּל־הַיֹּ֑ום וְאֵ֥ין לְאֵ֖ל יָדֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: ثَمَرُ أَرْضِكَ وَكُلُّ تَعَبِكَ يَأْكُلُهُ شَعْبٌ لَا تَعْرِفُهُ، فَلَا تَكُونُ إِلَّا مَظْلُومًا وَمَسْحُوقًا كُلَّ ٱلْأَيَّامِ.
verses.kjv: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
verses.web: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,
verses.he: פְּרִ֤י אַדְמָֽתְךָ֙ וְכָל־יְגִ֣יעֲךָ֔ יֹאכַ֥ל עַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָדָ֑עְתָּ וְהָיִ֗יתָ רַ֛ק עָשׁ֥וּק וְרָצ֖וּץ כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ مَجْنُونًا مِنْ مَنْظَرِ عَيْنَيْكَ ٱلَّذِي تَنْظُرُ.
verses.kjv: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.web: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
verses.he: וְהָיִ֖יתָ מְשֻׁגָּ֑ע מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

verses.ar: يَضْرِبُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ بِقَرْحٍ خَبِيثٍ عَلَى ٱلرُّكْبَتَيْنِ وَعَلَى ٱلسَّاقَيْنِ، حَتَّى لَا تَسْتَطِيعَ ٱلشِّفَاءَ مِنْ أَسْفَلِ قَدَمِكَ إِلَى قِمَّةِ رَأْسِكَ.
verses.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
verses.web: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
verses.he: יַכְּכָ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֗ע עַל־הַבִּרְכַּ֙יִם֙ וְעַל־הַשֹּׁקַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תוּכַ֖ל לְהֵרָפֵ֑א מִכַּ֥ף רַגְלְךָ֖ וְעַ֥ד קָדְקֳדֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: يَذْهَبُ بِكَ ٱلرَّبُّ وَبِمَلِكِكَ ٱلَّذِي تُقِيمُهُ عَلَيْكَ إِلَى أُمَّةٍ لَمْ تَعْرِفْهَا أَنْتَ وَلَا آبَاؤُكَ، وَتَعْبُدُ هُنَاكَ آلِهَةً أُخْرَى مِنْ خَشَبٍ وَحَجَرٍ،
verses.kjv: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.web: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.
verses.he: יֹולֵ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֹֽתְךָ֗ וְאֶֽת־מַלְכְּךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּקִ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ אֶל־גֹּ֕וי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדַ֖עְתָּ אַתָּ֣ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְעָבַ֥דְתָּ שָּׁ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ دَهَشًا وَمَثَلًا وَهُزْأَةً فِي جَمِيعِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسُوقُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَيْهِمْ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
verses.web: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
verses.he: וְהָיִ֣יתָ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה לְמָשָׁ֖ל וְלִשְׁנִינָ֑ה בְּכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־יְנַהֶגְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה שָֽׁמָּה׃

verses.ar: بِذَارًا كَثِيرًا تُخْرِجُ إِلَى ٱلْحَقْلِ، وَقَلِيلًا تَجْمَعُ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْجَرَادَ يَأْكُلُهُ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather [but] little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.web: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
verses.he: זֶ֥רַע רַ֖ב תֹּוצִ֣יא הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּמְעַ֣ט תֶּאֱסֹ֔ף כִּ֥י יַחְסְלֶ֖נּוּ הָאַרְבֶּֽה׃

verses.ar: كُرُومًا تَغْرِسُ وَتَشْتَغِلُ، وَخَمْرًا لَا تَشْرَبُ وَلَا تَجْنِي، لِأَنَّ ٱلدُّودَ يَأْكُلُهَا.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress [them], but shalt neither drink [of] the wine, nor gather [the grapes;] for the worms shall eat them.
verses.web: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.
verses.he: כְּרָמִ֥ים תִּטַּ֖ע וְעָבָ֑דְתָּ וְיַ֤יִן לֹֽא־תִשְׁתֶּה֙ וְלֹ֣א תֶאֱגֹ֔ר כִּ֥י תֹאכְלֶ֖נּוּ הַתֹּלָֽעַת׃

verses.ar: يَكُونُ لَكَ زَيْتُونٌ فِي جَمِيعِ تُخُومِكَ، وَبِزَيْتٍ لَا تَدَّهِنُ، لِأَنَّ زَيْتُونَكَ يَنْتَثِرُ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint [thyself] with the oil; for thine olive shall cast [his fruit].
verses.web: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.
verses.he: זֵיתִ֛ים יִהְי֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּכָל־גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְשֶׁ֙מֶן֙ לֹ֣א תָס֔וּךְ כִּ֥י יִשַּׁ֖ל זֵיתֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: بَنِينَ وَبَنَاتٍ تَلِدُ وَلَا يَكُونُونَ لَكَ، لِأَنَّهُمْ إِلَى ٱلسَّبْيِ يَذْهَبُونَ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.web: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
verses.he: בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנֹ֖ות תֹּולִ֑יד וְלֹא־יִהְי֣וּ לָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י יֵלְכ֖וּ בַּשֶּֽׁבִי׃

verses.ar: جَمِيعُ أَشْجَارِكَ وَأَثْمَارِ أَرْضِكَ يَتَوَلَّاهُ ٱلصَّرْصَرُ.
verses.kjv: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
verses.web: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
verses.he: כָּל־עֵצְךָ֖ וּפְרִ֣י אַדְמָתֶ֑ךָ יְיָרֵ֖שׁ הַצְּלָצַֽל׃

verses.ar: اَلْغَرِيبُ ٱلَّذِي فِي وَسَطِكَ يَسْتَعْلِي عَلَيْكَ مُتَصَاعِدًا، وَأَنْتَ تَنْحَطُّ مُتَنَازِلًا.
verses.kjv: The stranger that [is] within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
verses.web: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.
verses.he: הַגֵּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֔ יַעֲלֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ מַ֣עְלָה מָּ֑עְלָה וְאַתָּ֥ה תֵרֵ֖ד מַ֥טָּה מָּֽטָּה׃

verses.ar: هُوَ يُقْرِضُكَ وَأَنْتَ لَا تُقْرِضُهُ. هُوَ يَكُونُ رَأْسًا وَأَنْتَ تَكُونُ ذَنَبًا.
verses.kjv: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.web: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
verses.he: ה֣וּא יַלְוְךָ֔ וְאַתָּ֖ה לֹ֣א תַלְוֶ֑נּוּ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְרֹ֔אשׁ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לְזָנָֽב׃

verses.ar: وَتَأْتِي عَلَيْكَ جَمِيعُ هَذِهِ ٱللَّعَنَاتِ وَتَتَّبِعُكَ وَتُدْرِكُكَ حَتَّى تَهْلِكَ، لِأَنَّكَ لَمْ تَسْمَعْ لِصَوْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ لِتَحْفَظَ وَصَايَاهُ وَفَرَائِضَهُ ٱلَّتِي أَوْصَاكَ بِهَا.
verses.kjv: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.web: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.
verses.he: וּבָ֨אוּ עָלֶ֜יךָ כָּל־הַקְּלָלֹ֣ות הָאֵ֗לֶּה וּרְדָפ֙וּךָ֙ וְהִשִּׂיג֔וּךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָ֑ךְ כִּי־לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ בְּקֹול֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לִשְׁמֹ֛ר מִצְוֹתָ֥יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: فَتَكُونُ فِيكَ آيَةً وَأُعْجُوبَةً وَفِي نَسْلِكَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.web: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
verses.he: וְהָי֣וּ בְךָ֔ לְאֹ֖ות וּלְמֹופֵ֑ת וּֽבְזַרְעֲךָ֖ עַד־עֹולָֽם׃

verses.ar: مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَعْبُدِ ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ بِفَرَحٍ وَبِطِيبَةِ قَلْبٍ لِكَثْرَةِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ.
verses.kjv: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all [things;]
verses.web: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
verses.he: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־עָבַ֙דְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּשִׂמְחָ֖ה וּבְט֣וּב לֵבָ֑ב מֵרֹ֖ב כֹּֽל׃

verses.ar: تُسْتَعْبَدُ لِأَعْدَائِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرْسِلُهُمُ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَيْكَ فِي جُوعٍ وَعَطَشٍ وَعُرْيٍ وَعَوَزِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ. فَيَجْعَلُ نِيرَ حَدِيدٍ عَلَى عُنُقِكَ حَتَّى يُهْلِكَكَ.
verses.kjv: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all [things:] and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.web: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.
verses.he: וְעָבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת־אֹיְבֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשַׁלְּחֶ֤נּוּ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ בְּרָעָ֧ב וּבְצָמָ֛א וּבְעֵירֹ֖ם וּבְחֹ֣סֶר כֹּ֑ל וְנָתַ֞ן עֹ֤ל בַּרְזֶל֙ עַל־צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִידֹ֖ו אֹתָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: يَجْلِبُ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَيْكَ أُمَّةً مِنْ بَعِيدٍ، مِنْ أَقْصَاءِ ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمَا يَطِيرُ ٱلنَّسْرُ، أُمَّةً لَا تَفْهَمُ لِسَانَهَا،
verses.kjv: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, [as swift] as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.web: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,
verses.he: יִשָּׂ֣א יְהוָה֩ עָלֶ֨יךָ גֹּ֤וי מֵרָחֹוק֙ מִקְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִדְאֶ֖ה הַנָּ֑שֶׁר גֹּ֕וי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־תִשְׁמַ֖ע לְשֹׁנֹֽו׃

verses.ar: أُمَّةً جَافِيَةَ ٱلْوَجْهِ لَا تَهَابُ ٱلشَّيْخَ وَلَا تَحِنُّ إِلَى ٱلْوَلَدِ،
verses.kjv: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
verses.web: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.
verses.he: גֹּ֖וי עַ֣ז פָּנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יִשָּׂ֤א פָנִים֙ לְזָקֵ֔ן וְנַ֖עַר לֹ֥א יָחֹֽן׃

verses.ar: فَتَأْكُلُ ثَمَرَةَ بَهَائِمِكَ وَثَمَرَةَ أَرْضِكَ حَتَّى تَهْلِكَ، وَلَا تُبْقِي لَكَ قَمْحًا وَلَا خَمْرًا وَلَا زَيْتًا، وَلَا نِتَاجَ بَقَرِكَ وَلَا إِنَاثَ غَنَمِكَ، حَتَّى تُفْنِيَكَ.
verses.kjv: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which [also] shall not leave thee [either] corn, wine, or oil, [or] the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.web: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.
verses.he: וְ֠אָכַל פְּרִ֨י בְהֶמְתְּךָ֥ וּפְרִֽי־אַדְמָתְךָ֮ עַ֣ד הִשָּֽׁמְדָךְ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יַשְׁאִ֜יר לְךָ֗ דָּגָן֙ תִּירֹ֣ושׁ וְיִצְהָ֔ר שְׁגַ֥ר אֲלָפֶ֖יךָ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֑ךָ עַ֥ד הַאֲבִידֹ֖ו אֹתָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: وَتُحَاصِرُكَ فِي جَمِيعِ أَبْوَابِكَ حَتَّى تَهْبِطَ أَسْوَارُكَ ٱلشَّامِخَةُ ٱلْحَصِينَةُ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتَ تَثِقُ بِهَا فِي كُلِّ أَرْضِكَ. تُحَاصِرُكَ فِي جَمِيعِ أَبْوَابِكَ، فِي كُلِّ أَرْضِكَ ٱلَّتِي يُعْطِيكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ.
verses.kjv: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
verses.web: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which Yahweh your God has given you.
verses.he: וְהֵצַ֨ר לְךָ֜ בְּכָל־שְׁעָרֶ֗יךָ עַ֣ד רֶ֤דֶת חֹמֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ הַגְּבֹהֹ֣ות וְהַבְּצֻרֹ֔ות אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖ן בְּכָל־אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהֵצַ֤ר לְךָ֙ בְּכָל־שְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ בְּכָ֨ל־אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: فَتَأْكُلُ ثَمَرَةَ بَطْنِكَ، لَحْمَ بَنِيكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَعْطَاكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُكَ فِي ٱلْحِصَارِ وَٱلضِّيقَةِ ٱلَّتِي يُضَايِقُكَ بِهَا عَدُوُّكَ.
verses.kjv: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
verses.web: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.
verses.he: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ פְרִֽי־בִטְנְךָ֗ בְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּמָצֹור֙ וּבְמָצֹ֔וק אֲשֶׁר־יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֖ אֹיְבֶֽךָ׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلْمُتَنَعِّمُ فِيكَ وَٱلْمُتَرَفِّهُ جِدًّا، تَبْخُلُ عَيْنُهُ عَلَى أَخِيهِ وَٱمْرَأَةِ حِضْنِهِ وَبَقِيَّةِ أَوْلَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُبْقِيهِمْ،
verses.kjv: [So that] the man [that is] tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.web: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,
verses.he: הָאִישׁ֙ הָרַ֣ךְ בְּךָ֔ וְהֶעָנֹ֖ג מְאֹ֑ד תֵּרַ֨ע עֵינֹ֤ו בְאָחִיו֙ וּבְאֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיקֹ֔ו וּבְיֶ֥תֶר בָּנָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹותִֽיר׃

verses.ar: بِأَنْ يُعْطِيَ أَحَدَهُمْ مِنْ لَحْمِ بَنِيهِ ٱلَّذِي يَأْكُلُهُ، لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يُبْقَ لَهُ شَيْءٌ فِي ٱلْحِصَارِ وَٱلضِّيقَةِ ٱلَّتِي يُضَايِقُكَ بِهَا عَدُوُّكَ فِي جَمِيعِ أَبْوَابِكَ.
verses.kjv: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.web: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.
verses.he: מִתֵּ֣ת ׀ לְאַחַ֣ד מֵהֶ֗ם מִבְּשַׂ֤ר בָּנָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל מִבְּלִ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־לֹ֖ו כֹּ֑ל בְּמָצֹור֙ וּבְמָצֹ֔וק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בְּכָל־שְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: وَٱلْمَرْأَةُ ٱلْمُتَنَعِّمَةُ فِيكَ وَٱلْمُتَرَفِّهَةُ ٱلَّتِي لَمْ تُجَرِّبْ أَنْ تَضَعَ أَسْفَلَ قَدَمِهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِلتَّنَعُّمِ وَٱلتَّرَفُّهِ، تَبْخَلُ عَيْنُهَا عَلَى رَجُلِ حِضْنِهَا وَعَلَى ٱبْنِهَا وَبِنْتِهَا
verses.kjv: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.web: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,
verses.he: הָרַכָּ֨ה בְךָ֜ וְהָעֲנֻגָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־נִסְּתָ֤ה כַף־רַגְלָהּ֙ הַצֵּ֣ג עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵהִתְעַנֵּ֖ג וּמֵרֹ֑ךְ תֵּרַ֤ע עֵינָהּ֙ בְּאִ֣ישׁ חֵיקָ֔הּ וּבִבְנָ֖הּ וּבְבִתָּֽהּ׃

verses.ar: بِمَشِيمَتِهَا ٱلْخَارِجَةِ مِنْ بَيْنِ رِجْلَيْهَا وَبِأَوْلَادِهَا ٱلَّذِينَ تَلِدُهُمْ، لِأَنَّهَا تَأْكُلُهُمْ سِرًّا فِي عَوَزِ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فِي ٱلْحِصَارِ وَٱلضِّيقَةِ ٱلَّتِي يُضَايِقُكَ بِهَا عَدُوُّكَ فِي أَبْوَابِكَ.
verses.kjv: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all [things] secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
verses.web: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.
verses.he: וּֽבְשִׁלְיָתָ֞הּ הַיֹּוצֵ֣ת ׀ מִבֵּ֣ין רַגְלֶ֗יהָ וּבְבָנֶ֙יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּלֵ֔ד כִּֽי־תֹאכְלֵ֥ם בְּחֹֽסֶר־כֹּ֖ל בַּסָּ֑תֶר בְּמָצֹור֙ וּבְמָצֹ֔וק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֥יק לְךָ֛ אֹיִבְךָ֖ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: إِنْ لَمْ تَحْرِصْ لِتَعْمَلَ بِجَمِيعِ كَلِمَاتِ هَذَا ٱلنَّامُوسِ ٱلْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي هَذَا ٱلسِّفْرِ، لِتَهَابَ هَذَا ٱلِٱسْمَ ٱلْجَلِيلَ ٱلْمَرْهُوبَ، ٱلرَّبَّ إِلَهَكَ،
verses.kjv: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
verses.web: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,
verses.he: אִם־לֹ֨א תִשְׁמֹ֜ר לַעֲשֹׂ֗ות אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי֙ הַתֹּורָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את הַכְּתוּבִ֖ים בַּסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת־הַשֵּׁ֞ם הַנִּכְבָּ֤ד וְהַנֹּורָא֙ הַזֶּ֔ה אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: يَجْعَلُ ٱلرَّبُّ ضَرَبَاتِكَ وَضَرَبَاتِ نَسْلِكَ عَجِيبَةً. ضَرَبَاتٍ عَظِيمَةً رَاسِخَةً، وَأَمْرَاضًا رَدِيَّةً ثَابِتَةً.
verses.kjv: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, [even] great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.web: then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.
verses.he: וְהִפְלָ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֶת־מַכֹּ֣תְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת מַכֹּ֣ות זַרְעֶ֑ךָ מַכֹּ֤ות גְּדֹלֹות֙ וְנֶ֣אֱמָנֹ֔ות וָחֳלָיִ֥ם רָעִ֖ים וְנֶאֱמָנִֽים׃

verses.ar: وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْكَ جَمِيعَ أَدْوَاءِ مِصْرَ ٱلَّتِي فَزِعْتَ مِنْهَا، فَتَلْتَصِقُ بِكَ.
verses.kjv: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.web: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.
verses.he: וְהֵשִׁ֣יב בְּךָ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל־מַדְוֵ֣ה מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגֹ֖רְתָּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְדָבְק֖וּ בָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: أَيْضًا كُلُّ مَرَضٍ وَكُلُّ ضَرْبَةٍ لَمْ تُكْتَبْ فِي سِفْرِ ٱلنَّامُوسِ هَذَا، يُسَلِّطُهُ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَيْكَ حَتَّى تَهْلِكَ.
verses.kjv: Also every sickness, and every plague, which [is] not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.web: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until you are destroyed.
verses.he: גַּ֤ם כָּל־חֳלִי֙ וְכָל־מַכָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א כָת֔וּב בְּסֵ֖פֶר הַתֹּורָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את יַעְלֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽךְ׃

verses.ar: فَتَبْقَوْنَ نَفَرًا قَلِيلًا عِوَضَ مَا كُنْتُمْ كَنُجُومِ ٱلسَّمَاءِ فِي ٱلْكَثْرَةِ، لِأَنَّكَ لَمْ تَسْمَعْ لِصَوْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ.
verses.kjv: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.web: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
verses.he: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ בִּמְתֵ֣י מְעָ֔ט תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱיִיתֶ֔ם כְּכֹוכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹ֑ב כִּי־לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ בְּקֹ֖ול יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: وَكَمَا فَرِحَ ٱلرَّبُّ لَكُمْ لِيُحْسِنَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَيُكَثِّرَكُمْ، كَذَلِكَ يَفْرَحُ ٱلرَّبُّ لَكُمْ لِيُفْنِيَكُمْ وَيُهْلِكَكُمْ، فَتُسْتَأْصَلُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِي أَنْتَ دَاخِلٌ إِلَيْهَا لِتَمْتَلِكَهَا.
verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, [that] as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.web: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.
verses.he: וְ֠הָיָה כַּאֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֨שׂ יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם לְהֵיטִ֣יב אֶתְכֶם֮ וּלְהַרְבֹּ֣ות אֶתְכֶם֒ כֵּ֣ן יָשִׂ֤ישׂ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם לְהַאֲבִ֥יד אֶתְכֶ֖ם וּלְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְנִסַּחְתֶּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הֽ͏ָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

verses.ar: وَيُبَدِّدُكَ ٱلرَّبُّ فِي جَمِيعِ ٱلشُّعُوبِ مِنْ أَقْصَاءِ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَى أَقْصَائِهَا، وَتَعْبُدُ هُنَاكَ آلِهَةً أُخْرَى لَمْ تَعْرِفْهَا أَنْتَ وَلَا آبَاؤُكَ، مِنْ خَشَبٍ وَحَجَرٍ.
verses.kjv: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, [even] wood and stone.
verses.web: Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.
verses.he: וֶהֱפִֽיצְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ בְּכָל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ וְעַד־קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעָבַ֨דְתָּ שָּׁ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־יָדַ֛עְתָּ אַתָּ֥ה וַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ עֵ֥ץ וָאָֽבֶן׃

verses.ar: وَفِي تِلْكَ ٱلْأُمَمِ لَا تَطْمَئِنُّ وَلَا يَكُونُ قَرَارٌ لِقَدَمِكَ، بَلْ يُعْطِيكَ ٱلرَّبُّ هُنَاكَ قَلْبًا مُرْتَجِفًا وَكَلَالَ ٱلْعَيْنَيْنِ وَذُبُولَ ٱلنَّفْسِ.
verses.kjv: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.web: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.
verses.he: וּבַגֹּויִ֤ם הָהֵם֙ לֹ֣א תַרְגִּ֔יעַ וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנֹ֖וחַ לְכַף־רַגְלֶ֑ךָ וְנָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה לְךָ֥ שָׁם֙ לֵ֣ב רַגָּ֔ז וְכִלְיֹ֥ון עֵינַ֖יִם וְדֽ͏ַאֲבֹ֥ון נָֽפֶשׁ׃

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ حَيَاتُكَ مُعَلَّقَةً قُدَّامَكَ، وَتَرْتَعِبُ لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا وَلَا تَأْمَنُ عَلَى حَيَاتِكَ.
verses.kjv: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
verses.web: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.
verses.he: וְהָי֣וּ חַיֶּ֔יךָ תְּלֻאִ֥ים לְךָ֖ מִנֶּ֑גֶד וּפָֽחַדְתָּ֙ לַ֣יְלָה וְיֹומָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ין בְּחַיֶּֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: فِي ٱلصَّبَاحِ تَقُولُ: يَا لَيْتَهُ ٱلْمَسَاءُ، وَفِي ٱلْمَسَاءِ تَقُولُ: يَا لَيْتَهُ ٱلصَّبَاحُ، مِنِ ٱرْتِعَابِ قَلْبِكَ ٱلَّذِي تَرْتَعِبُ، وَمِنْ مَنْظَرِ عَيْنَيْكَ ٱلَّذِي تَنْظُرُ.
verses.kjv: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.web: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.
verses.he: בַּבֹּ֤קֶר תֹּאמַר֙ מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן עֶ֔רֶב וּבָעֶ֥רֶב תֹּאמַ֖ר מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן בֹּ֑קֶר מִפַּ֤חַד לְבָֽבְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּפְחָ֔ד וּמִמַּרְאֵ֥ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃

verses.ar: وَيَرُدُّكَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَى مِصْرَ فِي سُفُنٍ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ ٱلَّتِي قُلْتُ لَكَ لَا تَعُدْ تَرَاهَا، فَتُبَاعُونَ هُنَاكَ لِأَعْدَائِكَ عَبِيدًا وَإِمَاءً، وَلَيْسَ مَنْ يَشْتَرِي».
verses.kjv: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy [you].
verses.web: Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.
verses.he: וֶֽהֱשִֽׁיבְךָ֨ יְהוָ֥ה ׀ מִצְרַיִם֮ בָּאֳנִיֹּות֒ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣רְתִּֽי לְךָ֔ לֹא־תֹסִ֥יף עֹ֖וד לִרְאֹתָ֑הּ וְהִתְמַכַּרְתֶּ֨ם שָׁ֧ם לְאֹיְבֶ֛יךָ לַעֲבָדִ֥ים וְלִשְׁפָחֹ֖ות וְאֵ֥ין קֹנֶֽה׃ ס
